item.title: How Chitra Banerjee’s Independence Does Justice To Narrating Women’s Stories
item.description: As Chitra Banerjee explores the lives of the three sisters as they navigate grief, dreams, and ambitions, she ensures that the reader gets the perspective of all three girls throughout the book. item.title: Legalising Domination: Afghanistan’s New Rule On Domestic Violence
item.description: Afghanistan's new Domestic Violence policy not only overlooks the crisis, but turns DV into a state enabled social structure under the Taliban. The post Legalising Domination: Afghanistan’s New Rule On Domestic Violence appeared first on Feminism in India.
